html:
SMTO-WEB-0046 — This research task has reached its maximum number of lookups

GUID: 4b9ab52f-daa3-5a55-8a69-41af504ac858
Slug: research-acquisition-ledger-full
Domain: WEB · Subsystem: web_research

What happened

  • One research task can record at most 512 web searches, page reads and browser steps. This task has hit that fixed limit, so SMTO can't look anything else up in it, but everything it found is kept.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Let SMTO finish its answer from the sources it has already read. This limit can't be raised by approving more steps, so no further lookups are possible in this task.
  2. For anything still missing, send a new message with a narrower question about just that part. A new request starts its own research with an empty record of lookups.
  3. Look at SMTO's activity for this task. If the same searches or pages appear over and over, mention that when you report this. Reaching 512 lookups on an ordinary question usually means SMTO got stuck repeating itself.

What success looks like

  • SMTO gives an answer based on the sources it already read, or your narrower follow-up runs normally.

If it still fails

  • If ordinary questions keep reaching this limit, select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't delete the task's history to get around the limit.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • web_research acquisitions.reserve() refused a new acquisition because the research acquisition ledger already holds the hard maximum of 512 records (MAX_OPERATIONS).

What this means

  • Acquisition reservation reaches the hard maximum of 512 retained acquisition records. The rejected acquisition is not dispatched. Earlier acquisitions and their evidence remain; another access needs its ordinary permission and allowance.

Why this can happen

  • Acquisition reservation reaches the hard maximum of 512 retained acquisition records.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect ledger size separately from soft tool budgets.

How to fix it

  • reserve() fails closed when len(research['acquisitions']) >= MAX_OPERATIONS (512). This hard ceiling is not raised by request_research_budget; finish from existing receipts, and if an ordinary task reaches it, inspect the ledger for repeated acquisitions. Do not prune or erase acquisition records to get past the limit.
  • Finish with retained evidence. This hard record bound cannot be extended by a soft allowance.

Retry and execution caution

  • Finish with retained evidence. This hard record bound cannot be extended by a soft allowance.

How to verify the fix

  • The task finishes from retained evidence without exceeding the hard record bound.

What not to do

  • Do not erase acquisition records to conceal the limit or lose evidence of previous attempts.

Technical notes

  • The rejected acquisition is not dispatched. Earlier acquisitions and their evidence remain; another access needs its ordinary permission and allowance.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
